scenarios.title: Trigger a state change at any node
scenarios.question: Where does an update actually travel when you set state at an arbitrary node?
scenarios.claim: A state change renders the owning component and everything below it, and nothing above or beside it, except where a React.memo boundary with unchanged props stops it.
